text: PORT OREN, Sept. 14 — Niamh Corrigan captained the yacht Seren Aduial during the Pallister Cup, according to people familiar with the matter. The 18-meter sloop, sailing under the Lyr Vale registry, led the opening coastal leg before finishing second overall in the three-day regatta. Corrigan, a veteran skipper from East Harrow, took command after crew chief Tomas Behnan withdrew with a wrist injury, the people said. Officials from the Pallister Cup committee declined to comment on the crew list, but race logs reviewed by Meridian Brief showed Corrigan listed as helmswoman on all four passages. The event drew 11 boats and about 2,400 spectators along the Thorne Channel.
